Class GameSnapshot

java.lang.Object
mesos.client.ui.model.GameSnapshot
public class GameSnapshot extends Object
Client-side mirror of the server state. After the colleagues' refactor the server pushes a full SnapshotMessage on every model change, so this class is now a plain projector of that DTO: no more line parsing. UI components subscribe via addListener(Runnable) and receive callbacks on the calling thread. applySnapshot(SnapshotMessage) must be called from the EDT for GUI clients.
